decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity builds directly on the firm's owned fibre networks and engineering know-how, so the firm can interpret its results and improve it, and its promotion to the home page in 2019 signals strategic importance.

The voice number ordering portal draws on the firm's software platforms and voice regulatory expertise, but the firm has been pruning other legacy voice products and the portal was only mentioned rather than promoted, so it is at moderate risk while still likely to be kept as a support tool.
